description.value: Ukrainian Village Restaurant is a sit-down Ukrainian restaurant located at the corner of Robson and Denman Street in downtown Vancouver, serving homemade classics like borscht, perogies, and cabbage rolls made from traditional recipes. It sits on Denman Street, a well-travelled cycling corridor connecting Stanley Park to the broader West End, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the area. The restaurant also has a bar component and accepts reservations by phone.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 44m; stands (2 spaces) at 53m. Total: 4 spaces.
